# Destiny Life Church — app legal pages

**Generated. Do not edit these files here.**

They are published from `legal/` in the app repository by
`scripts/publish-legal.mjs`. Edit them there and run `npm run legal`;
anything changed in this repo is overwritten on the next publish.

This repo exists only so the pages have a public URL. The app repository is
private, and GitHub Pages on a private repo requires a paid plan.

| Used for | URL |
| --- | --- |
| Privacy policy (App Store and Google Play) | https://kerebino.github.io/dlc-legal/privacy-policy.html |
| Support URL (App Store) | https://kerebino.github.io/dlc-legal/support.html |
| Data deletion request (Google Play) | https://kerebino.github.io/dlc-legal/support.html#delete-my-data |
